=== .env.local gitignored? ===
web_application/.env.local

observation.command:
echo "=== .dockerignore (does it exclude .env.local?) ==="; cat /workspace/.dockerignore 2>&1
echo
echo "=== Is .env.local present inside the 3003 image? ==="; docker exec vereinfacht-web_application-1 sh -c 'ls -la /app/.env* 2>&1; echo "---"; cat /app/.env.local 2>/dev/null | sed -E "s/(SECRET=|TOKEN=).*/\1[REDACTED]/"'
echo
echo "=== .env.local gitignored? ==="; git -C /workspace check-ignore web_application/.env.local 2>&1
